name: Rainquail
pitch: Your sprinklers, your yard, and just the right amount of water.
lead: Your sprinklers, your yard, and just the right amount of water. Rainquail maps every head in your yard, lays out your programs in plain words, and reads the forecast so each zone gets what it needs. With a supported Rain Bird Wi-Fi controller, it can run your sprinklers over your own home network too.
features: Put your yard plan or a photo from above in the app, then pin every sprinkler head, valve box and the main shutoff where it really is. Tap any of them to see its zone, its parts and its photos.
Programs A to D show their days, start times and each zone's minutes in plain words. Edit one and Rainquail sums up exactly what will change before it saves, and flags start times that overlap.
The week ahead, day by day
This week's watering lists each day's programs, zones and times for the next 7 days, and marks any run that lands in your city's no-watering window or a rain delay.
Each week Rainquail checks the coming days' heat and rain against what your lawn needs, and shows how many minutes each zone really needs. Each zone is marked Over, Under or About right.
Know what each zone puts down
A quick catch-cup test tells Rainquail how many inches an hour each zone waters, so its advice fits your heads and your water pressure, not a guess.
The Parts list shows every head's maker, model, nozzle and arc, with counts, ready to share as text or a spreadsheet when it's time to buy replacements.
data: Everything lives on your phone, and Rainquail talks to your controller over your own home Wi-Fi. Daily Backup saves a copy to your own Google Drive, where only Rainquail can see the files it made.
Weather comes from your ZIP code, never your phone's location.
plans: Every feature on your phone, with no sign-in needed.
Buy once and keep it for good: a copy of your yard, zones and programs to your own Google Drive every day, at a time you pick, and whenever you ask.
Use Rainquail on more than one phone. A change on one shows on the others.
A new phone has your whole yard.
Connect your own AI app, so you can talk to it about your sprinklers, and it makes changes only when you say so.
